name: Azure Monitor
tagline: Collect, analyze and act on telemetry.
whatItIs: The unified monitoring platform for metrics, logs, alerts, insights and workbooks across Azure, hybrid and multicloud resources.
primaryPurpose: Observe the health and performance of resources and applications.
security: Control workspace access with RBAC (workspace or resource-context)
networking: Azure Monitor Private Link Scope (AMPLS) for private ingestion and queries
pricing: Platform metrics free; pay for log ingestion/retention, alert rules, and some features.

confusedWith.name: Microsoft Sentinel
confusedWith.difference: SIEM built on Log Analytics; Azure Monitor is operational monitoring.

relevanceNote: Metrics, log settings, KQL, alerts and insights are explicit skills.
examTips: No resource logs without a diagnostic setting

name: Log Analytics Workspace
tagline: Store and query logs with KQL.
whatItIs: A workspace that stores log data in tables and lets you query it with Kusto Query Language.
primaryPurpose: Central log store for analysis, alerts and dashboards.
security: Use resource-context RBAC to scope access to data from resources users can see
pricing: Per GB ingested (with commitment tiers) and retention beyond included days; archive and query costs for some plans.

confusedWith.name: Storage account archive
confusedWith.difference: Storage archives logs cheaply but isn't queryable with KQL.

relevanceNote: Querying and analyzing logs is an explicit skill.
examTips: KQL: Table | where | summarize count() by

name: Application Insights
whatItIs: A feature of Azure Monitor that collects application telemetry — requests, dependencies, exceptions, traces — via SDKs or OpenTelemetry.
primaryPurpose: Understand and troubleshoot application behavior and performance.
security: Connection strings identify the resource; restrict ingestion with Entra auth where needed
networking: Telemetry sent over HTTPS; private ingestion via AMPLS
pricing: Billed by data ingested into the Log Analytics workspace.

confusedWith.name: VM insights
confusedWith.difference: Infrastructure monitoring of VMs; App Insights monitors application code.

relevanceNote: Concept-level knowledge as part of Azure Monitor.

name: Azure Backup
tagline: Managed backup for Azure and on-premises workloads.
whatItIs: A backup service using Recovery Services vaults and Backup vaults, with policies, secure storage and flexible restore.
primaryPurpose: Recover data to a previous point in time.
security: Encryption with platform or customer-managed keys
networking: Private endpoints for vaults (for some workloads)
pricing: Per protected instance (by size) plus backup storage consumed (by redundancy).

confusedWith.name: Site Recovery
confusedWith.difference: Replication and failover for DR vs point-in-time restore.

relevanceNote: Vaults, policies, backup/restore and reports are explicit skills.
examTips: Vault in same region as VMs

name: Azure Site Recovery
tagline: Disaster recovery through replication and failover.
whatItIs: A service that replicates VMs and physical servers to a secondary location and orchestrates failover and failback.
networking: Map target VNets; plan IP addressing and DNS for failover
pricing: Per protected instance per month (with an initial free period per instance), plus storage and compute during failover.

confusedWith.name: Azure Backup
confusedWith.difference: Backup restores data; ASR fails over running workloads.

relevanceNote: Configuring ASR and performing failover are explicit skills.
examTips: Test failover uses an isolated network
